task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OIDC-02 at src/design/oidc-02-keycloak-adapter.md. Define the concrete Keycloak 26.x adapter that implements the OIDC-01 IdentityProvider contract while keeping all Keycloak-specific URLs, payloads, and behavior isolated to the adapter package. Specify module layout, endpoint responsibilities, request/response mappings, error handling, dependency boundaries, test seams, and compile-isolation guarantees so removing the adapter does not affect non-adapter module compilation. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines the Keycloak adapter package structure and how it implements the OIDC-01 contract
Design keeps Keycloak-specific concerns isolated to adapter-only modules
Design maps OIDC-02 acceptance criteria to concrete validation or test points
Design identifies backend touchpoints, build wiring, and compile-isolation expectations
Design references Keycloak 26.x Quarkus distribution assumptions where relevant

result.summary: Designed the OIDC-02 Keycloak 26.x adapter at src/design/oidc-02-keycloak-adapter.md, covering package structure, OIDC-01 contract implementation surface, endpoint and payload mappings, error handling, dependency boundaries, test seams, and compile-isolation/build-wiring guarantees.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for Keycloak adapter implementation, then TEST-DESIGNER for adapter conformance and compile-isolation coverage.
